newsitem.title: USA: American States premiums fuel Q1 growth.
newsitem.headline: American States premiums fuel Q1 growth.

text.p: American States Financial Corp said Tuesday solid growth in its premiums contributed to an increase in earnings in the first quarter ended March 31.

The insurance holding company reported net income of $54.0 million, or $0.90 a share, compared to $46.9 million, or $0.94, a year ago. There were 60.0 million shares outstanding in 1997, compared to 50.0 million in 1996, American States said.
Revenues slipped to $501.9 million from $513.4 million in spite of a 4.2-percent increase in net written premiums.
The company said it expects its growth rate will exceed the industry growth rate for the first time in many quarters.
American States shares were up 1/8 Tuesday at 33-3/4.
